reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: sync path (checkColumnResponse at request_manager.nim:190) only calls verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof, which validates Merkle proof but not kzg_commitments length. Gossip path (peerdas_helpers.nim:359) correctly rejects empty kzg_commitments. Spec deviation confirmed per 01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json line 262-279: 'kzg_commitments must not be empty in a valid data column sidecar.' However, severity downgraded from MEDIUM to Low: impact limited to sync protocol bypass (not gossip), and empty list edge case has limited practical exploitability (honest blocks never have zero blobs with data columns, and gossip layer provides defense-in-depth). Single-client bug affecting sync-only path justifies Low severity per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE threshold criteria.
